description: Generic table component tag contract. Table-shape-level metadata only: a single object tag describing the table's cells and optional row/column policies. No nested child components.

rows.description: Optional per-row policies, keyed by row index.

row.description: Zero-based row index this policy applies to.

content_policy.description: Content policy for the row: required means its cells should be filled, optional means they may be filled. Does not control rendering.

instruction.description: Optional guidance for generating this row's cells.

columns.description: Optional per-column policies, keyed by column index.

col.description: Zero-based column index this policy applies to.

content_policy.description: Content policy for the column: required means its cells should be filled, optional means they may be filled. Does not control rendering.

instruction.description: Optional guidance for generating this column's cells.

cells.description: Per-cell configuration. May be empty when no cells are configured (every cell is then preserved / left as authored).

row.description: Zero-based row index of the cell.

col.description: Zero-based column index of the cell.

render_action.description: Whether the renderer writes into this cell: render allows AI-provided content to be written, preserve keeps the cell's existing content unchanged. Optional — a missing render_action means preserve.

text_format.description: How the generated cell text should be structured.

instruction.description: Optional guidance for generating this cell's content.

max_chars_per_item.description: Maximum characters for each generated line/item in the cell — a strict limit that must never be exceeded; shorten or compact content until it fits.

max_lines.description: Maximum number of lines for this cell — a strict limit that must never be exceeded; shorten or compact content until it fits.

max_chars_per_line.description: Maximum characters per line for this cell — a strict limit that must never be exceeded; shorten or compact content until it fits.

example.efficio_prompt_instruction: Generate table content that respects each cell's render action.
